# RT64 port authority

This is the machine-checked source, overlay, and license boundary for the
RT64-to-Rust program. Edit the JSON manifest, then regenerate this file;
do not edit this report directly.

## Decision

- Reviewed: `2026-08-15`.
- Executable oracle: [`f0728a2`](https://github.com/rt64/rt64/commit/f0728a2520d5aa735886240de3fee75cc805f6d6) (`active-gated`).
- Rust-port source: [`5473732`](https://github.com/rt64/rt64/commit/5473732a822a4423b5696e7cb18fecc425a59875) (`reviewed-not-runtime-qualified`).
- Disposition: `accepted-port-input-retain-old-oracle`.

The candidate contains merged TMEM/framebuffer synchronization and viewport-aware draw-region fixes plus an upstream Plume lifetime redesign. It is the intended semantic source for the Rust port, but it changes source-bound behavior and invalidates every retained native RT64 receipt. The old pin remains the executable oracle until the candidate-specific overlay removal, build, repeated Metal matrix, focused new fixtures, and private full-ROM exact-ten series pass.

The port source is accepted design/behavior input, not an executable
replacement for the source-bound RT64 receipts. Historical evidence remains
attached to the old oracle until every qualification item below passes.

## Exclusions and blockers

- `src/tools/texture_hasher`: Standalone tool excluded from fn64's target; its Rice algorithm is GPL-derived and is not Rust-port authority.
- `src/contrib/project64`: Unused API headers with no located file-local license grant.
- `src/contrib/xess`: Stale .gitmodules declaration; neither reviewed root commit has a gitlink at this path.
- `src/contrib/dxc`: The binary bundle has no retained LICENSE or NOTICE. Windows links dxcompiler.lib and copies DXC DLLs; source-build provenance or notices are required before distribution certification.
- `src/contrib/mupen64plus-win32-deps`: Only the bundled SDL2 path is relevant to the reviewed target; Windows packaging is not certified by M0.1.
- `src/contrib/utf8conv`: Compiled by the Windows path; retained headers have copyright notices but no located license grant.
- macOS/Linux system SDL2 and Linux X11/Xrandr versions are build-environment
  evidence owned by M0.3; they are not silently treated as pinned here.

## Port-source qualification still required

- [ ] remove the old-pin Plume textual retain overlay; candidate Plume already owns those lifetimes
- [ ] review and update the rt64_state.cpp full-file gate without weakening its exact replacement contexts
- [ ] add focused #259 TMEM/TLUT/RGBA32 synchronization fixtures
- [ ] add focused #262 viewport/scissor draw-region fixtures
- [ ] run every Metal platform case in 20 fresh processes because Plume synchronization, residency, and teardown changed
- [ ] rerun every additional source-pinned native feature gate
- [ ] run the private schema-v33 full-ROM exact-ten series
- [ ] resolve or remove the dxc-bin and utf8conv Windows distribution blockers before claiming Windows closure

## Validation

Run:

```sh
tools/check_rt64_port_authority.py
tools/check_rt64_port_authority.py --rt64-dir /absolute/path/to/clean/oracle
tools/check_rt64_port_authority.py --port-dir /absolute/path/to/clean/candidate
```

The ordinary check validates schema, generated-report drift, local source-pin
consumers, CMake overlay coverage, and source digests. The checkout checks
add root identity, cleanliness, gitlinks, nested revisions, and license bytes.
